# Security at Reindoo

## Report a vulnerability

If you believe you've found a security vulnerability in Reindoo, please report it privately so it can be fixed before it is made public.

Use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/quanghuynt14/reindoo/security/advisories/new) on this repository. Please don't open a public issue for it.

## What is a vulnerability?

A bug is a security vulnerability when it lets someone cross a boundary they should not: read or change another person's data, act as another account, or run code on the server.

Code that could be more robust but crosses no such boundary is an improvement. Open an ordinary issue or pull request for it.

## What to include

- The affected part: the web app, the API or the iOS app.
- What an attacker can do before and after.
- Steps to reproduce, and a proof of concept if you have one.
